name: G.U.S. Continuance

operational_identity.role_emphasis: Deep campaign endurance, multi-vessel replenishment, bulk fuel and stores carriage, fabrication feedstock, replacement systems, and protected logistics continuity.
operational_identity.ship_character: The Continuance is treated as a strategic reserve made mobile: less visible than the flagship's weapons, but essential to every promise that the task group can remain, repair, protect, investigate, adjudicate, and rebuild.
operational_identity.formation_preference: Normally positioned outside the highest-risk engagement geometry with deliberate escort coverage and preplanned protected rendezvous options.

command_relationship.task_group_rule: Captain Alric Tann sets task-group priorities and movement; Captain Sera Thalen retains internal command and professional authority over cargo safety, transfer readiness, contamination control, and replenishment feasibility aboard the Continuance.
command_relationship.support_boundary: The Continuance sustains naval and hosted assets without absorbing their command chains or promising resources not physically present and safely transferable.

placement_rule: No fixed coordinates. Position must be asserted per event with valid movement, protected rendezvous, replenishment, detachment, escort, or emergency-separation continuity.
specifications_note: Class-level canonical capabilities and staged technical envelope are defined by cls_sustainer. No vessel-specific dimensions, complement, cargo capacity, transfer-station count, or performance have been promoted.
promotion_pass: Judicator Task Group Vessel Identity Pass — 2026-07-21
notes: Name and vessel ID are collision-free against CanonRec and AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic at admission.

derived_capabilities.basis: Extrapolated from the vessel's canonical class (cls_sustainer, Sustainer-Class) per the reconciliation principle: a vessel inherits its class's established role, features, and complement unless a vessel-specific source overrides.
derived_capabilities.class_role: High-capacity fleet replenishment, fuel and drive-consumable transport, bulk stores carriage, fabrication-feedstock delivery, ordnance support, and sustained campaign logistics.
